Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't activate from breeding areas.
Card Q&A.q: This Digimon is in my breeding area when I digivolve it into a Diaboromon from my hand. Does this card's effect activate?

Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon digivolves into a [Diaboromon] in your hand, reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 1.
